column3: MT 18:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew; NKJV adds “A Psalm” to the title and renders “I love you” as “I will love You.”
Close to the Hebrew; the second סַלְעִי (“my rock”) is rendered “my strength,” “take refuge” “trust,” and the last “refuge” “my stronghold.”
Close to the Hebrew; חֶבְלֵי־ (“the cords”) is rendered “The pangs,” and בְלִיַּעַל (“Belial, worthlessness”) “ungodliness.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the cords of Sheol” is rendered “The sorrows of Sheol.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the mountains” is rendered “the hills.”
Close to the Hebrew; סִתְרוֹ (“his hiding place”) is rendered “His secret place.”
Close to the Hebrew; “lightnings he shot” is rendered “Lightnings in abundance,” and NKJV supplies “the foe.”
Close to the Hebrew; “he stretched out [his hand]” is rendered “He sent.”
Close to the Hebrew; עִם־ חָסִיד (“the loyal”) is rendered “the merciful.”
Close to the Hebrew; תִּתְפַּתָּל (“show yourself twisted”) is rendered “show Yourself shrewd.”
Close to the Hebrew; גְּדוּד (“a raiding band”) is rendered “a troop.”
Close to the Hebrew; צְרוּפָה (“refined”) is rendered “proven,” and “take refuge” “trust.”
